item.tib: dbal chen ge khod kyi dbang khrid byin rlabs sprin dpung
item.coloph: de ltar gsang ba drag chen ldog med gser gyi spu gri/ lha rgyud stong phrag drug bcu'i yang bcud/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dbang gi mchog byin rlabs bsdud byed dbang gi go rim 'di ni/ mar ston lhun grub dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor la brten nas/ mkhas grub shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi phyag len ci lta ba bzhin du/ btsun pa mnga' ris bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so/ nyes 'gal ci mchis skyabs yul gnyan la bshags/ dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog/
